text:
dylan r: starting Marlin LoRA bring-up into pegasus-13b. quick objectives: token-stability (specials: '#ORD', 'AMT$', '<INV>'), int3 quant smoke, and invoice formatting checks. kicking off quickpack.

jay p: command: `./quickpack --base pegasus-13b --lora marlin_invoices_v1.safetensors --quant int3 --checks token_stability,invoice_format --out runs/marlin_qp_1791230000`

mira sood: include 'weird_hashes.json' and 'currency_locales.json' (EUR + NOK variants). Marlin previously used a compound token '#ORD' baked into training, must preserve.

eval-bot: queued (id=marlin-qp-1791230000) on node p-qe-gpu-04. logs -> runs/marlin_qp_1791230000/log.txt

dylan r: initial quickpass done: 4/10 checks failed. failures: (1) '#ORD' split to '#' + 'ORD', (2) '<INV>' emitted with spaces '< INV >', (3) trailing zero drop on amounts (.00 -> .0), (4) thousand-sep inconsistencies for NOK. sample output: `expected: "#ORD-0002" got: "ORD-0002"` (we lost the hash completely in one case).

mira sood: token aliasing again. check merge log for alias warnings and token_diff.json. Did merge run with `--auto-token-merge`?

dylan r: yes used auto merge. merge log snippet: `WARN token_alias: '#ORD' id 62113 collides -> aliased to seq ['#','ORD']` Also saw: `WARN token_prune: id 62113 marked unused by aggressive prune`.

jay p: two issues: aliasing and aggressive prune removing special id. quick fix flow: (1) create vocab_lock.json pinning '#ORD' and '<INV>' to original ids from customer's training, (2) re-run merge with `--vocab-lock`, (3) quantize with `--prune conservative --rounding bankers --preserve-special`, (4) attach token_diff.json to artifacts.

dylan r: crafting lock file: `{ "#ORD": "62113", "<INV>": "59901", "AMT$": "60220" }`. re-run: `./quickpack --base pegasus-13b --lora marlin_invoices_v1.safetensors --vocab-lock marlin_vocab_lock.json --quant int3 --quant-opts "--prune conservative --rounding bankers --preserve-special" --out runs/marlin_qp_1791230000_rerun`

infra-bot: queued on p-qe-gpu-10, ETA ~3m.

eval-bot: re-run started id=marlin-qp-1791230000-r1. streaming -> runs/marlin_qp_1791230000_rerun/log.txt

dylan r: quick status: re-run finished. results: 9/10 pass. token stability fixed: '#ORD' preserved, '<INV>' preserved. amount formatting fixed. remaining issue: a small behavioral regression on verbose description paraphrase set (ROUGE-L -1.0) for sequences >1200 tokens.

mira sood: ROUGE drop expected with int3 on long contexts. recommended mitigations: mixed-KV int8 cache on canary or fallback int4 for long-docs. which does Marlin need? they handle long invoices occasionally.

jay p: propose canary: enable mixed-KV (int8) on dedicated pool and run a 1-hour traffic replay. estimate latency p95 +8% and cost +7% but quality should recover. also add a pre-merge CI gate "protected-token-stability" that errors if any protected token maps to multi-token sequence after merge. I'll open PR with tests.

dylan r: agreed. I'll inform AE and schedule canary for next Tue. saving artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/marlin/1791230000/rerun/report.html and runs/marlin_qp_1791230000_rerun/token_diff.json attached.

eval-bot: advisory: int3 decode shows CPU overhead on long contexts (+6% p95) and increased tokenization handling when many protected tokens exist.

mira sood: small ops/process note: update onboarding checklist to require customer_protected_tokens.txt and recommend conservative prune by default for LoRA merges.

jay p: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/merge-tool/pull/302 (adds token-stability gate + examples).

dylan r: thanks all. closing quickpack thread, artifacts saved, will follow-up on canary scheduling. :white_check_mark:
